title: Les --- And What the Second System Costs
label: ch:pronoun-les
canDo: I can say les digo and name the four pronouns that are identical in both object systems.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C46-les: produce les digo and say how many genuinely new words the indirect set adds.
payoff.note: The arithmetic is the lesson: a second complete table costs exactly two new words, because me, te, nos and os do both jobs unchanged.
